main.fieldsClassification: The category breakdown is Fiscal.ge’s classification based on official functional (COFOG) codes.
main.ministriesClassification: Fiscal.ge groups institutions using the programme classification in budget execution reports.
main.noSelection: No series selected. Choose a series from the series panel.
main.noRangeData: No data is available for the selected series in this range. Widen the range or change the series.
main.sourceData: Data: reviewed official budget documents (Ministry of Finance of Georgia). Receipts cover the consolidated budget; expenditure covers the state budget. Their difference is not the deficit.
main.annualExecution: · Actual execution for the full 12 months.
main.missing2004Liabilities: The increase in liabilities for 2004 is unavailable and is excluded from the 2004 total.
main.activePlanned: The displayed values include planned budget data.
main.noPeriod: Change cannot be measured over a single year — select a range longer than one year.
main.metadataExpenditureDescription: Georgia’s actual state-budget expenditure by function and institution, {firstYear}–{lastYear}.
main.metadataRevenueDescription: Georgia’s actual consolidated-budget receipts: taxes, grants and other receipts, {firstYear}–{lastYear}.
